breaking.title: Antony Waste shares in focus after 9 workers killed in Pune waste mound collapse; operations halted
breaking.summary: Nine workers died after a waste mound collapsed at Antony Waste Handling Cell's plant. The incident occurred following exceptionally heavy rainfall which destabilized the waste mound. The company will cover all medical and funeral expenses for affected families. Financial assistance of twenty-five lakh rupees will be provided to each bereaved family. Operations at the waste-to-energy plant are temporarily suspended for safety assessments.

breaking.title: Europe death toll tops 10,000 during late-June heatwave; scientists blame human-caused climate change
breaking.summary: Europe recorded over ten thousand excess deaths during a late June heatwave. Older populations, aged sixty-five and above, were most severely impacted by the extreme heat. Scientists link this heatwave's intensity and frequency to human-caused climate change. France and Belgium reported very high excess mortality during the final week of June.
